summary: This short note is a biographical stub about Mallory Horne. It states that Horne was a pilot in the United States Army Air Forces during World War II and that he attended the University of Florida, where he served as Chancellor of the Student Government Honor Court in 1949.
one_line: Mallory Horne was a WWII United States Army Air Forces pilot who attended the University of Florida and was Chancellor of its Student Government Honor Court in 1949.
key_facts: Mallory Horne was a pilot in the United States Army Air Forces during World War II.
Mallory Horne attended the University of Florida.
Mallory Horne served as the Chancellor of the Student Government Honor Court in 1949.
The Student Government Honor Court is associated with the University of Florida in this note.
